tools.name: get_availability
tools.title: Get consultation availability
tools.description: Return the set of already-booked consultation slot start times (ISO UTC) between two dates. Any working-hour slot NOT in this list is available. Slots are 1 hour, Mon-Fri, Kigali time (CAT/UTC+2), at 09:00, 10:00, 11:00, 14:00, and 15:00 local.

fromIso.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601 UTC (e.g. 2026-07-20T00:00:00Z).

toIso.description: End of the range, ISO 8601 UTC. Must be within 8 weeks of now.

tools.name: list_my_bookings
tools.title: List my bookings
tools.description: List consultation bookings for the signed-in user (matched by their account email).

includeCancelled.description: Include cancelled bookings. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.title: Book a consultation
tools.description: Book a 1-hour consultation slot for the signed-in user. slotStartUtc must be an available working-hour slot returned by get_availability (Mon-Fri, 09:00/10:00/11:00/14:00/15:00 Kigali time). The booking is made under the signed-in user's account email.

slotStartUtc.description: ISO 8601 UTC start of the slot.

jurisdiction.description: Country or region of the matter.

matterType.description: Area of law (e.g. Corporate, Litigation, Tax).

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel a booking
tools.description: Cancel one of the signed-in user's consultation bookings. Look up the booking with list_my_bookings first to get its cancellation_token. Cancellations within 24 hours of the appointment are subject to the full consultation fee.
